## Context / Problem

The plan-review harness needs a frozen, versioned corpus of past reviews it can replay. `plan_review_result_v2` sidecars (written by `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sidecar.py`) already retain the Pass-1 findings, Pass-2 answer vectors and Pass-3 outputs per finding, but (a) `sidecar.prune` has deleted ~5,000 `REVIEW_RESULT` files from the tree (recoverable from `origin/tickets` history; `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/harnesses/mine_outcome_corpus.py` already walks git objects this way), (b) the reviewed plan text is stored only as `material_fingerprint`, and (c) compaction has folded most pre-review `EDIT` events into `SNAPSHOT`s, so the at-review description must be reconstructed from git history. The `~/legacy-modernization-navigator` store (74 sidecars, different project overlay) should be included for overlay diversity.

## Approach

Build `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/corpus.py`:

1. Enumerate sidecars from a list of store roots (each a tickets-branch checkout or a git ref), reading tree files plus deleted `*-REVIEW_RESULT.json` blobs from history — reuse the exact incantation already tested and compat-handled in `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/harnesses/mine_outcome_corpus.py` (git-history-deleted-blob enumeration), not a fresh `git log --diff-filter=D` reimplementation. Keep only `data.schema in {plan_review_result_v1, plan_review_result_v2}`; record schema version, `impact_model_version`, `regver`, `verified_at_sha`, `provider_provenance.ran_model`, `review_phase`.
2. Reconstruct the reviewed material per sidecar: replay `CREATE`/`EDIT` (tree + history-deleted) up to the sidecar timestamp for description and file_impact, resolve child pins from `reviewed_related_material`, and rebuild a full `PlanContext` (carrying `file_impact_scope` / `no_file_impact_reason` alongside description/file_impact/children) so the conditional `file_impact_scope` component is included in the recompute exactly as the signer computed it (`material_diff.material_basis` hashes it only when `file_impact_scope == "none"`). Recompute the fingerprint via `pass1.material_fingerprint` — mirroring `attest._legacy_material_ok` — trying it across the SAME generation ladder: current (normalized), pre-330c (raw, `normalize_checkboxes=False`), intermediate post-330c/pre-2be7 (`normalize_whitespace=False`), and post-2be7/pre-reason-normalization (`normalize_reason=False`). Mark a row `verified` if it matches under ANY generation, and record which generation matched. Fall back to the nearest `SNAPSHOT.compiled_state.description` and mark `unverified` when no generation matches.
3. Emit a manifest (`docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/replay/corpus-<date>.manifest.json`: per-store counts, verdict/schema/cohort/model histograms, verification coverage broken out by matched generation, content hash) and a compact JSONL corpus (one row per review with findings, verification vectors, material text) under a git-ignored cache dir with the manifest hash as the reproducibility key. Assume rebuild-from-manifest is deterministic; the JSONL itself is not committed.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/__init__.py`, `corpus.py` (new)
- `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/replay/corpus-*.manifest.json` (new)
- `.gitignore` (replay cache dir)
- `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_corpus.py` (new)

## Testing

Unit: a fixture store with one tree sidecar, one history-deleted sidecar, one compacted ticket → all three enumerated; fingerprint verification passes for a ticket whose EDIT history is intact (including one fixture verified only under a non-current generation, and one fixture with `file_impact_scope == "none"` verified only once the conditional basis component is included) and is marked `unverified` for one that was snapshotted with a later edit; v1 sidecars are loaded with the missing fields marked absent, not defaulted. Empty store → empty manifest, exit 0. Integration (manual, recorded in the manifest): a full build over both real stores.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Running the builder over the rebar and legacy-modernization-navigator stores produces a manifest whose sidecar count is ≥ the tree count plus the history-recovered count, with per-store and per-schema totals; checked by reading the manifest.
- [ ] The manifest reports `verified_ratio` (the fraction of v2 sidecars whose reviewed material reconstructs and matches `material_fingerprint` under any generation in the ladder) broken out by matched generation; no threshold is asserted as a hard gate in this ticket — the observed ratio from the real build is the input the epic's later noise-floor/label work (`expectable-clownlike-ynambu`) uses to decide whether a floor is warranted; checked by reading the manifest's `verified_ratio` field and per-generation breakdown.
- [ ] Rebuilding from the same store refs yields an identical manifest content hash; checked by running twice and diffing.
- [ ] The builder makes no LLM calls and needs no network beyond a local git fetch; checked by running with no provider credentials.
- [ ] Unit tests above pass in `make test`.
